answer_1.quote: We created a range of templates encoding various syntactic relations which require gender agreement, and assess whether the translation includes the correct morphological inflection ... We test English→German and English→French, chosen based on English not having grammatical gender while German and French both do.
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences with gendered morphology and sentiment-bearing words, used to measure gender agreement accuracy and sentiment bias.

answer_2.quote: BLEU score reported on wmt18 test set for en-de and wmt14 test set for en-fr... Metrics: We measure accuracy, Acc, the proportion of the number of key nouns are translated into the correct form... We also report word-level positiveness t and sentence-level positiveness s.
